what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

cases.name: corrected-goal-live-pair-gate-readback
argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd ../../..
MANIFEST="$(find skills/persona-dream/evals -name pd_corrected_goal_v1.json -print -quit)"
test -n "$MANIFEST"
SOURCE_ROOT="skills/persona-dream/local/proofs/pd-corrected-goal-v1/live-pair-20260822T170000Z"
RUN_ROOT="/tmp/persona-dream-corrected-goal-live-pair-gate-readback-run"
PAIR_OUT="/tmp/persona-dream-corrected-goal-live-pair-gate-readback-pair-runner.json"
READBACK="/tmp/persona-dream-corrected-goal-live-pair-gate-readback.json"
rm -rf "$RUN_ROOT"
cp -a "$SOURCE_ROOT" "$RUN_ROOT"
bash skills/persona-dream/run.sh corrected-goal-pair --manifest "$MANIFEST" --out "$RUN_ROOT" --require-live --forbid-mocked > "$PAIR_OUT"
bash skills/persona-dream/run.sh adjudicate-corrected-goal --manifest "$MANIFEST" --run-root "$RUN_ROOT" --out "$READBACK" --fail-closed
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
pair = json.loads(Path('/tmp/persona-dream-corrected-goal-live-pair-gate-readback-pair-runner.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
receipt = json.loads(Path('/tmp/persona-dream-corrected-goal-live-pair-gate-readback.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert pair['status'] == 'PASS_CORRECTED_GOAL_PAIR_ARTIFACTS_PRESENT'
assert pair['mocked'] is False
assert pair['live'] is True
assert pair['missing_live_artifacts'] == []
assert receipt['status'] == 'PASS_CORRECTED_GOAL_PAIRED_PROOF'
assert receipt['mocked'] is False
assert receipt['live'] is True
assert receipt['failures'] == []
assert receipt['gate_statuses']['answer_invariance'] == 'PASS_ANSWER_INVARIANCE'
assert receipt['gate_statuses']['emotional_carryover'] == 'PASS_EMOTION_LINEAGE'
assert receipt['gate_statuses']['chatterbox_delivery'] == 'PASS_CHATTERBOX_DELIVERY'
print(pair['status'])
print('CORRECTED_GOAL_LIVE_PAIR_GATE_READBACK_OK')
PY
